say:1:1910810001:1.text: Hey, Elphira! You're inside that monster, right? Can you hear me?
say:1:1910810001:1.source_cn: 喂，艾菲拉！你就在那个怪物身体里，你听得到咱说话，对吧？！

say:2:1910810002:1.text: Didn't you say your family meant the most to you?! Didn't you say you wanted to protect Coralia?!
say:2:1910810002:1.source_cn: 你不是说，你最在意你的家人吗？你不是说，你想保护塔拉萨吗！

say:3:1910810003:1.text: Didn't you say the boss and I here were your friends?!
say:3:1910810003:1.source_cn: 你不是说……老大和咱是你的朋友吗！

say:4:1910810004:1.text: Why do you keep attacking us?! Wake up, Elphira! Damn it, wake up!!!
say:4:1910810004:1.source_cn: 为什么变成这副模样，还一直打咱们！快醒醒，艾菲拉，该死...

say:5:1910810005:1.text: At the sound of Tolan's hoarse screaming, the tentacles thrashing wildly seem, for a moment, to truly stop.
say:5:1910810005:1.source_cn: 听到图澜声嘶力竭的喊叫后，那些狂乱挥舞着的触须似乎真的...
say:5:1910810005:1.male: At the sound of Tolan's hoarse screaming, the tentacles thrashing wildly seem, for a moment, to truly stop.
say:5:1910810005:1.female: At the sound of Tolan's hoarse screaming, the tentacles thrashing wildly seem, for a moment, to truly stop.

say:6:1910810006:1.text: But the hesitation lasts only an instant. Before you can react, the tentacles are lashing at you again, more vicious than before.
say:6:1910810006:1.source_cn: 但那片刻的迟疑实在太过短暂，不等你们反应过来，那些触须...
say:6:1910810006:1.male: But the hesitation lasts only an instant. Before you can react, the tentacles are lashing at you again, more vicious than before.
say:6:1910810006:1.female: But the hesitation lasts only an instant. Before you can react, the tentacles are lashing at you again, more vicious than before.

say:7:1910810007:1.text: Damn it, can she even hear me?!
say:7:1910810007:1.source_cn: 该死……她到底能不能听到咱说的话啊！
say:7:1910810007:1.male: Damn it, can she even hear me?!
say:7:1910810007:1.female: Damn it, can she even hear me?!

choice_prompt:8:1910810007.text: Damn it, can she even hear me?!

choice_prompt:8:1910810007.female: Damn it, can she even hear me?!

choice:8:0:1.text: Don't lose heart. Elphira is fighting it too.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 别灰心，艾菲拉一定也在努力
choice:8:0:1.male: Don't lose heart. Elphira is fighting it too.
choice:8:0:1.female: Don't lose heart. Elphira is fighting it too.

choice:8:1:2.text: This won't wake her. We have to reach the goddess's body!
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 光凭这样无法唤醒她，先接近母神的本体！
choice:8:1:2.male: This won't wake her. We have to reach the goddess's body!
